summary: Advances a timed UI animation. Resolves an animation configuration block through ConditionalDelegation_6460 using the selector at this+0x84; aborts when the block is missing or when its frame-count field at +0x40 is empty (resetting this+0x88 to zero). Otherwise accumulates time delta (FloatFieldAccessor over the field at this+0x40) into the progress float at this+0x80; when the accumulator exceeds the threshold at block+0x18, decrements the repeat count at this+0xDC and, when it reaches zero, resolves the UI string via UIStringAccessor_6280, looks up its renderer with sub_497E80 and applies RendererAlphaBlendSetter. Resets the accumulator, then advances the frame index at this+0x88 either clamped to or wrapped by the frame count at block+0x10 depending on the mode at block+0x1C, returning 1 on a trigger and 0 otherwise.

local_names.v12: advance mode at block+0x1C (0 = clamp, 1 = wrap)

operations.description: Resolve the animation configuration block: ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, *(this + 0x84)) using the config selector field
If the resolved configuration block is null, return 0 (no trigger)
If the configuration block's frame-count field at +0x40 is empty, reset this+0x88 to 0 and return 0
Accumulate progress: v6 = FloatFieldAccessor(field at this+0x40) + *(float*)(this + 0x80); store v6 back into this+0x80
If the accumulated progress v6 exceeds the threshold float at block+0x18, enter the trigger path
Decrement the remaining repeat count at this+0xDC by 1; when it reaches zero, run the renderer-refresh path
Renderer refresh: fetch the UI string via UIStringAccessor_6280(this); when non-empty, look it up with sub_497E80 and, if found, set the alpha-blend mode via RendererAlphaBlendSetter
Reset the progress accumulator this+0x80 back to 0 after a trigger
Advance the frame index this+0x88 by 1; mode 0 at block+0x1C clamps to the frame count at block+0x10, mode 1 wraps with modulo
Return 1 when the animation triggered, 0 otherwise
